meta.name: learn-codebase
meta.description: Prime a codebase by reading every source file in full. Use when starting work on a new or unfamiliar project, or when the user asks to "learn the codebase", "read the codebase", "prime", or "get up to speed".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 快速熟悉陌生代码库的完整结构
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果刚接手一个不熟悉的项目，需要快速理解代码全貌。
copy.tagline_en: Quickly understand the full structure of an unfamiliar codebase
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you just took over an unfamiliar project and need to grasp the codebase quickly.

howto.what: 这个技能会让 Claude 逐个完整读取代码库中的所有源文件；遇到大文件时分块读取，从而全面掌握代码内容。
howto.when: 在开始新项目或不熟悉的项目时，或当你说“学习代码库”“读取代码库”“prime”等关键词时触发。

say.note: Claude 会逐个文件完整读取源码。

say.text: 读取代码库，帮我快速熟悉项目
say.note: 它会通读全部源文件并加深理解。

say.text: 帮我熟悉这个项目，读一遍全部源码
say.note: 适合接手陌生项目时使用。

howto.what_en: This skill makes Claude read every source file in the codebase in full, using paging for large files, to build a thorough understanding of the code.
howto.when_en: Triggered when starting work on a new or unfamiliar project, or when the user asks to 'learn the codebase', 'read the codebase', 'prime', or 'get up to speed'.

say_en.note: Claude will read every source file in full.

say_en.text: Read the codebase and help me get familiar with the project.
say_en.note: It will read all files and deepen understanding.

say_en.text: Help me get up to speed by reading all the source code.
say_en.note: Good for taking over an unfamiliar project.
